scope_basis: Grant upgrades weather observation stations and training so the country produces standard meteorological data; no separate non-data use is named.
title: SOFF Investment Phase — São Tomé and Príncipe systematic-observations upgrade
description: Investment to strengthen São Tomé and Príncipe's meteorological infrastructure and institutional capacity: upgrade of two automatic weather stations and rehabilitation of one upper-air station, alongside specialised training and strategic management support, targeting compliance with the Global Basic Observing Network (GBON). Approved at the 14th SOFF Steering Committee Meeting, held in Brussels 27–29 May 2026 and co-chaired by WMO and Belgium's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
recipient_organisation: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe

scope_basis: Budget support with pillars on state-enterprise oversight, fiscal transparency and energy supply beside telecoms competition and digital ID.
title: STP Fiscal Sustainability, Energy Access and Digital Connectivity Development Policy Financing
description: Development Policy Financing (budget-support) operation with two pillars: (i) strengthening SOE oversight and fiscal transparency, and (ii) strengthening energy supply and improving digital connectivity. On the digital side, prior actions increase telecoms-sector competition (results indicator: broadband users rising from a 146,000 baseline in Dec/2025 to a 172,000 target by Dec/2028) and set a target of 150,000 people (thousands, 50% female) with digitally verifiable identification by Dec/2028 against a zero baseline. The operation complements the Digital São Tomé and Príncipe Project (P177158, deal wb-stp-001) and the ASCENT regional energy programme, and is coordinated with an IMF Extended Credit Facility programme approved December 2024.
recipient_organisation: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
